desc: First published version, a draft. Its rules are the provisional steward's proposal, pending ratification by a governance body that has not yet been formed.
title: Open Animal Nutrition — Adequacy Interoperability Guide
introduction: An open, FHIR-based way to represent and verify the nutritional adequacy of an animal diet against published requirement standards (NRC, AAFCO, FEDIAF), on a common mathematical basis. Versions before 1.0.0 are drafts: their rules are the provisional steward's proposal, pending ratification by a governance body.
registry-description: Verifying the nutritional adequacy of an animal diet against published requirement standards (NRC, AAFCO, FEDIAF) on a common mathematical basis.
